# Calculate positions of separators between groups for log unit labels

    "weeks": [1, 2],
    "months": [1, 2, 4, 8],
    "years": [1, 2, 4, 8, 16]
}

    a_end = days_logunits[a_u[:-1]] * a_l[-1]
    b_start = days_logunits[b_u[:-1]] * b_l[0]
    log_midpoint = 10 ** ((np.log10(a_end) + np.log10(b_start))/2)
    days_logsep.append(log_midpoint)

# Calculate order for facets

# Generate human-readable units and tick positions for log timescales
#####################################################################

days_loglists = {
    "weeks": [1],
    "months": [1, 4],
    "years": [1, 3, 9]
}
days_logscale = []
days_loglabels_u = []
days_loglabels_full = []
days_loglabels_grp = []
for u, l in days_loglists.items():
    days_logscale.extend(days_logunits[u[:-1]] * i for i in l)
    # days_loglabels_u.extend(l)
    days_loglabels_u.extend(f"{x}{u[0]}" for x in l)
    days_loglabels_full.extend(f"{i} {u if i > 1 else u[:-1]}" for i in l)
    days_loglabels_grp.append(u)
days_logformatter = matplotlib.ticker.FixedFormatter(days_loglabels_u)
# Plot log scale charts
#######################
limits = {"x": (0.014*365.25, 10*365.25), "y": (None, 100)}
fig = plt.figure(layout="constrained", figsize=(4.2, 4.1))
subfigs = fig.subfigures(1, 2, width_ratios=[7, 6])
p = (
    so.Plot(data=hist_data, x="dur_years")
    .label(x="Duration (years)")
    .add(so.Bars(), so.Hist(binwidth=0.5), so.Stack(), color="ended", legend=False)
    .scale(x=so.Continuous().tick(every=2),
           color=so.Nominal(order=[True, False]))
    .facet(row="soc_move_type", order=facet_order)
    .limit(x=(0, 10))
    .on(subfigs[0])
    .plot()
)
p = (
    so.Plot(data=hist_data, x="dur_days")
    .label(x="Duration (log scale)")
    .add(so.Bars(), so.Hist(bins=20), so.Stack(), color="ended", legend=False)
    .scale(x=so.Continuous(trans="log").tick(at=days_logscale).label(formatter=days_logformatter),
           color=so.Nominal(order=[True, False]))
    .facet(row="soc_move_type", order=facet_order)
    .limit(x=limits["x"])
    .on(subfigs[1])
    .plot()
)
for ax in subfigs[1].axes:
    ax.yaxis.set_tick_params(labelleft=False)
fig_filename = "Figure_1.1.svg"
fig.savefig(output_dir + fig_filename, transparent=transparent)
plt.show()

                                     / route_outcomes[("outcomes", "n")].sum())
for k, v in stable_periods.items():
    route_outcomes[k, f"Eligible (n)"] = (soc_move_grp["pl_end_dt"]
                                 .apply(lambda x: (x < stable_period_max_end_dts[k]).sum()).astype("Int64"))
    for outcome in ["Yes", "No"]:

periodYears = {x: int(x[:-1]) * periodMult[x[-1]] / periodMult["y"] for x in distinct_pathways.stable_offsets.keys()}
plotdata = (
    tbl.unstack(0).loc["% returned"].reset_index(1)
    .assign(years=lambda x: x.index.map(periodYears))
    .reset_index()
)
zeroes = pd.DataFrame({"index": "", "End reason": plotdata["End reason"].unique(), "% returned": 0, "years": 0},
                      index=range(len(plotdata), len(plotdata) + plotdata["End reason"].nunique()))
plotdata = pd.concat([zeroes, plotdata])
facet_order = tbl_n.index.to_list()


def cust_plot(rc_params={}, annot_color="black"):
    return (
        so.Plot(data=plotdata, y="% returned", x="years", text="index")
        .facet("End reason", wrap=4, order=facet_order)
        .label(x="", y="")
        .add(so.Dot(), data=plotdata[plotdata["index"] != ""])
        .add(so.Line())
        .add(so.Area(edgewidth=0))
        .limit(x=(0, 5), y=(0, None))
        .scale(x=(so.Continuous()
                  .tick(every=1, minor=0)
                  .label(like=lambda x, pos: f"{x:.0f}" if x != 5 else "5y")),
              y=so.Continuous().tick(minor=1).label(unit=("", "%")))
        .theme({"axes.grid.which": "both"} | rc_params)
        .layout(size=(6.2, 2.1), engine="constrained")
    )
